sections.title: State Overview
paragraphs:
Maranhão is located in the Northeast region of Brazil with its capital in São Luís.
With a population of 7,100,000, Maranhão offers a unique blend of
opportunities and lifestyle experiences. The state is characterized by its Mining, Agriculture, Tourism, Energy
and is known for being Adventure-seekers and culture lovers welcome.

Climate:
Tropical - Hot and humid, rainy season March-August
Temperature Range:
24-32°C
Average Monthly Salary:
R$ 2,500-5,500 average monthly salary

sections.title: Economy & Employment
paragraphs:
Maranhão's economy is built on Mining, Agriculture, Tourism, Energy. The state offers significant opportunities
for both local and international professionals seeking employment and business ventures.

Employment Outlook:
Maranhão presents strong opportunities across multiple sectors,
with salaries ranging from R$ 2,500-5,500 average monthly salary for average positions.

sections.title: Education & Universities
paragraphs:
Maranhão boasts several excellent universities and educational institutions, making it ideal for
students and families seeking quality education.

Education Options:
From public universities to private institutions, Maranhão offers
diverse educational opportunities. Many universities offer programs in English for international students.
